platform_users_mobile_or_email.name: platform_users_mobile_or_email

norofile_files_dimensions.name: norofile_files_dimensions

norofile_user_files_dimensions.name: norofile_user_files_dimensions

billing_coupons_caps.name: billing_coupons_caps

billing_coupons_window.name: billing_coupons_window
